The Federal Aviation Administration launched a federal eVTOL pilot program in North Carolina, marking a decisive step toward integrating electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft into the national airspace system [FAA launched the program](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-celebrates-launch-federal-evtol-pilot-0). This initiative coincides with broader infrastructure investments, including a $1.1 billion airport upgrade package that equips 3,000 runway vehicles with transmitters at 61 airports [USDOT invested in upgrades](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-delivers-11-billion-upgrade-airports). The agency also introduced the SMART platform, which centralizes 200 data streams to improve airspace management and reduce flight delays [FAA introduced the platform](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-delivers-state-art-air-traffic-control). These actions signal a coordinated push to modernize aviation infrastructure while testing new mobility technologies.

Counter-drone capabilities are expanding significantly as defense contractors secure major contracts and establish a stronger U.S. presence. Leonardo DRS secured a $500 million ceiling contract for counter-drone radar with a Pentagon task force [Leonardo DRS secured the contract](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPd0t1d2t4Mk9TcmZZRzRkSzM3d01TcjJpcWpyUW9yX1JUN3BXTnZtNkdwV04zLU9WeU1JQXRoS0ZrQ0xJb212d1hoUWs3bDN1OW13R3ZHX2hQNkxwT25fa293VTBlMXlUbzZIN3N4Tm9ZckNUbVk2UUVhaVRMNXVuOFdzWDFyQnlKOE8xZTZ0Z04zM3gyN0xVSExvV2FjX2ZJS1JLVE5KMU9GT2ExOG9peGR5Uk5wQQ). Simultaneously, Denmark’s MyDefence opened its North American headquarters in Reston, Virginia, to support domestic operations [MyDefence opened headquarters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQMTVhTHQxRmdMNm94VGo4T0xjMkNzMVRSVWtFTHhETnd0TWZRUFo5NnNEYktEUGNhOGo3QzU0eWhTYWtERVg4VzFMeFg3LXU3bTF1dU4wUnp5QWNuQkpHTDBDV2lHZkpqYkhFTnpnRXNEVnc4bVNydWdPQWxRTmVaM1R5NGtmdXhmU3N2UGpBLVEtMHJIOVpmM2xoNXI3SHVqRThzbGktQm5YU1VJRnc?). The U.S. Army is also enhancing Stryker combat units with counter-drone warfare systems on NATO’s eastern flank, reflecting heightened security concerns [Army enhanced units](https://news.google.?).

In the drone sector, the FAA announced plans to double the size of its BEYOND program by selecting up to eight additional lead participants to advance drone integration [FAA announced expansion](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-announces-major-expansion-faa-beyond-program). This regulatory push aligns with industry growth, as 1.8 million registered U.S. drones now support a shift toward beyond visual line of sight operations [Drones support shift](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOUlJzRk5FOXVFdWNETWRMRHVzOExJVW9LUUJxUm9HZTRPSjJqTjd3NjdzMC1ZYWlPWXZJQTdpd0M0b0hTSm1Kd1ZQMFIyOHAtMUNMM292TmZTdzQ3VzM5LVBscVlUVy11ZzFjaURqbVZWb0lOa3hkTDZEU1dkV19OQ3FjM081ZlJ4OGpkV2JHMjNQdl9zSkhWakFBTV9wQQ?). Meanwhile, Tesla launched its Cybercab in Austin, initiating public testing of its autonomous vehicle technology [Tesla launched Cybercab](https://news.google.
